title: Cartesian Time Extent
description: Spatiotemporal point coordinates in Cartesian space with timestamps.

time.description: Array of point timestamps in seconds.

disjoint.description: Indicates whether all spatiotemporal points (time, x, y, z) are unique.

exhaustive.description: Indicates whether spatiotemporal observations cover the range without missing observations.

min_time.description: Lower bound of the time extent in seconds.

max_time.description: Upper bound of the time extent in seconds.

min_x.description: Lower bound along x-axis in space.

max_x.description: Upper bound along x-axis in space.

min_y.description: Lower bound along y-axis in space.

max_y.description: Upper bound along y-axis in space.

min_z.description: Lower bound along z-axis in space.

max_z.description: Upper bound along z-axis in space.
